panels.title: Signup funnel: where do users drop off?
panels.description: Ordered steps per visitor within window_seconds. Choose steps with the step variables.

targets.rawSql: WITH s1 AS (SELECT visitor_id, min(ts) AS t1, min(ts) AS tp FROM events WHERE site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name = '${step1}' GROUP BY visitor_id), s2 AS (SELECT a.visitor_id AS visitor_id, a.t1 AS t1, min(e.ts) AS tp FROM s1 a JOIN events e ON e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id WHERE e.site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.event_name = '${step2}' AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) > CAST(a.tp AS BIGINT) AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) <= CAST(a.t1 AS BIGINT) + ${window_seconds} * 1000 GROUP BY a.visitor_id, a.t1), s3 AS (SELECT a.visitor_id AS visitor_id, a.t1 AS t1, min(e.ts) AS tp FROM s2 a JOIN events e ON e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id WHERE e.site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.event_name = '${step3}' AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) > CAST(a.tp AS BIGINT) AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) <= CAST(a.t1 AS BIGINT) + ${window_seconds} * 1000 GROUP BY a.visitor_id, a.t1), s4 AS (SELECT a.visitor_id AS visitor_id, a.t1 AS t1, min(e.ts) AS tp FROM s3 a JOIN events e ON e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id WHERE e.site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.event_name = '${step4}' AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) > CAST(a.tp AS BIGINT) AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) <= CAST(a.t1 AS BIGINT) + ${window_seconds} * 1000 GROUP BY a.visitor_id, a.t1) SELECT event, visitors FROM (SELECT 1 AS step, '${step1}' AS event, count(*) AS visitors FROM s1 UNION ALL SELECT 2, '${step2}', count(*) FROM s2 UNION ALL SELECT 3, '${step3}', count(*) FROM s3 UNION ALL SELECT 4, '${step4}', count(*) FROM s4) u ORDER BY step

WITH s1 AS (SELECT visitor_id, min(ts) AS t1, min(ts) AS tp FROM events WHERE site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event_name = '${step1}' GROUP BY visitor_id), s2 AS (SELECT a.visitor_id AS visitor_id, a.t1 AS t1, min(e.ts) AS tp FROM s1 a JOIN events e ON e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id WHERE e.site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.event_name = '${step2}' AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) > CAST(a.tp AS BIGINT) AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) <= CAST(a.t1 AS BIGINT) + ${window_seconds} * 1000 GROUP BY a.visitor_id, a.t1), s3 AS (SELECT a.visitor_id AS visitor_id, a.t1 AS t1, min(e.ts) AS tp FROM s2 a JOIN events e ON e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id WHERE e.site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.event_name = '${step3}' AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) > CAST(a.tp AS BIGINT) AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) <= CAST(a.t1 AS BIGINT) + ${window_seconds} * 1000 GROUP BY a.visitor_id, a.t1), s4 AS (SELECT a.visitor_id AS visitor_id, a.t1 AS t1, min(e.ts) AS tp FROM s3 a JOIN events e ON e.visitor_id = a.visitor_id WHERE e.site_id = '${site}' AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.event_name = '${step4}' AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) > CAST(a.tp AS BIGINT) AND CAST(e.ts AS BIGINT) <= CAST(a.t1 AS BIGINT) + ${window_seconds} * 1000 GROUP BY a.visitor_id, a.t1) SELECT 1 AS step, '${step1}' AS event, count(*) AS visitors FROM s1 UNION ALL SELECT 2, '${step2}', count(*) FROM s2 UNION ALL SELECT 3, '${step3}', count(*) FROM s3 UNION ALL SELECT 4, '${step4}', count(*) FROM s4 ORDER BY step
